snippet.title: SuperLite 2000 Vol. 16: UNO Game - PlayStation 2 Gameplay
snippet.description:
As part of Success' SuperLite 2000 series, this is the enhanced PS2 version of the Japan-only UNO game that has anime characters and voice acting.

SuperLite 2000 (C) Success
UNO (C) Mattel
